context.situation: Neutral description of the decision as it appeared at the time.
context.decision: The bounded decision that had to be made.
context.decisionHorizon: When commitment or action was required.
context.recoveryHorizon: Known or reasonably foreseeable recovery/consequence horizon at T0.
context.uncertainties: Material uncertainties genuinely present at the time.

evidence.text: A contemporaneous observation, report, proposal, message or documented belief available before the decision.

documentedOptions: An option the protagonist explicitly believed available at T0, if documented.
absentPerspectives: A relevant party whose account was not available to the protagonist, if known at T0.
